shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ހަށިގަނޑު ހުރީ ކޮޅަށް. މޫނުގެ ހަންގަނޑު ވަނީ މަރުގެ ހުދުކުލައިން ބަދަލުވެ ދެލޯ މުޅިން ކަޅުވެފަ.
shots.narration_english: His body stood upright. The skin of his face had turned the white of death and his eyes had gone completely black.

shots.narration_dhivehi: އޭނާގެ ކަރުގައި ހުރި ފުން ޒަޚަމްތަކުން އަދިވެސް ކަޅުކުލައިގެ ލޭ ފައިބަމުންދިޔަ. އޭނާ ހުރީ އެމީހުންނާ ދިމާއަށް ބަލަހައްޓައިގެން އަތް ދިއްކޮށްލައިގެން.
shots.narration_english: From the deep wounds on his neck, black blood was still flowing. He stood staring towards them with his arm stretched out.
